script.text: Hi! Do you ship to Cordoba?
Yes, we ship nationwide. Cordoba takes 48 to 72 hs and it is free over $80,000.
Do you have the black jacket in size L?
Yes, 1 left in size L at $94,500. Here is the link to buy it right now 👉
Leave me your email and I will let you know when more sizes arrive.

layers.title: Your whole business online, in four layers
layers.subtitle: Start with the one that hurts most. Most people start with Support: it shows from day one.

attention.title: The assistant answers on its own
attention.body1: We train it with your PDFs, your prices and your website content. It answers the same hundred questions you answer today, in your brand voice, and hands the chat over to WhatsApp or email when a human is needed.
attention.body2: And it does not only live on your site: the same assistant also replies on WhatsApp and Instagram, with every conversation in a single panel.
attention.cta: Get a demo of the assistant

sales.title: Recommends and sells
sales.body: If you sell online, the assistant recommends real products from your store with price, stock and a buy link. It stops being a search box and starts being a salesperson.

presence.title: The site it lives on
presence.body: If your website is not up to par yet, we build it: fast, clear and designed to get you contacted.

operations.title: Everything in one panel
operations.body: Conversations, captured leads and what your customers keep asking. Every time someone leaves their details, you get an email.

process.title: From the first call to a live assistant
process.subtitle: You tell us how you handle questions today. We take care of the rest.

step1.title: We gather your information
step1.body: Your PDFs, your price list, your FAQs, your website. Everything that lives in your head or in a WhatsApp thread becomes the assistant knowledge base.

step2.title: We dress it in your brand
step2.body: Colors, name, welcome message and tone. We tune how it replies until it sounds like you and not like a generic robot.

step3.title: We install it and stay with you
step3.body: One line of code on your site and it is answering. Then we keep reviewing conversations with you to fine-tune whatever is needed.

answers.title: Assistant that answers
answers.subtitle: For the business that spends the day repeating itself.
items: Trained on your PDFs and website content, retrainable whenever you update
Chat window in your brand: colors, name and welcome message

sells.title: Assistant that also sells
sells.subtitle: Everything above, plus store and hand-off features.
items: Recommends real products with price, stock and buy link
Hands the chat to WhatsApp or email when a human is needed
Email alert every time a lead is captured
Automatic refresh of your site content
Premium AI model: better tone and brand handling
Advanced analytics: top questions and unanswered topics

process.note: Both versions run on the same platform: adding the sales features is a switch, not a restart. Pricing depends on your conversation volume — we define it in the demo.

manifesto.title: A customer who gets no answer never asks again
manifesto.subtitle: Sales are rarely lost on price. They are lost at eleven at night, when someone asks how much it costs and nobody replies until the next day.

tools.title: Tools, not promises
tools.body: We do not sell you “digital transformation”. We leave you something running that you can measure in the first week.

team.title: AI does not replace your team
team.body: It takes the repetitive questions so your people can be where the sale is actually won.

after.title: We stay afterwards
after.body: Launch day is not the end. It is when we start seeing what your customers really ask.

servicesBlock.title: Software shaped around how your business works
servicesBlock.subtitle: We are developers before we are plan sellers. If what you need does not fit in a box, we build it.

sites.title: Websites and landing pages
sites.body: The site the assistant lives on: fast, clear and designed to get you contacted. Technical maintenance included for the first months.

integrations.title: Third-party integrations
integrations.body: We connect what you already use: your store, your management system, payment providers, CRM, spreadsheets, WhatsApp. Let the data travel on its own instead of being copied by hand.

custom.title: Custom development
custom.body: Internal dashboards, automations, client portals — whatever your operation needs. We start from the concrete problem, not from a feature list.

items.q: Do I need to be technical to use it?
items.a: No. We configure, train and install it. You just open the panel to see conversations and captured leads, and that takes five minutes to learn.

items.q: Where does it get its answers from?
items.a: From what you give us: PDFs, price lists, FAQs and your website content. It does not make things up: if something is not loaded, it says so and hands the question to a human.

items.q: Does it work with my online store?
items.a: On the web it installs with one line of code on any site, whatever your store is built with. For it to also recommend real products with price, stock and buy link, your platform needs to let us connect to its catalog. Most do; we review it with you before starting and tell you straight what is possible.

items.q: How long until it is running?
items.a: It depends on how much information there is to load, but a typical start is one to two weeks from the moment we have your material.

items.q: Do you only build chatbots, or other software too?
items.a: We build the rest too: websites and landing pages, integrations with the tools you already use (store, management system, payments, CRM, spreadsheets, WhatsApp) and custom development such as internal dashboards or automations. You can hire just that, without the assistant.

items.q: Do I need a website to get the assistant?
items.a: Not necessarily: the assistant can answer on WhatsApp and Instagram even if you do not have a site yet. If you want one, we build it and everything lives in one place.
It depends on the version and the conversation volume your business gets. We define it together in the demo, with a fixed quote and no hidden costs.
